name: Fight Gone Bad

movements.notes: 10 ft target; 1 minute, scored in reps

description: Three five-minute rounds of five stations worked for a minute each: wall-ball shots, sumo deadlift high pulls, box jumps, push presses and rowing. One point per rep (or calorie on the rower), with a minute of rest between rounds.
source_notes: crossfit.com/workout/2008/06/25 (official CrossFit daily workout archive, first posted), retrieved 2026-10-16; one point per rep (per calorie on the rower), 1 minute of rest between the 5-minute rounds; the page lists a single set of loads
